quote: Let them a journey new begin, / But I at last with weary feet / Will turn towards the lighted inn, / My evening-rest and sleep to meet.
source: J. R. R. Tolkien, The Return of the King, Book VI, chapter 6, Many Partings (George Allen and Unwin, 1955) (Bilbo Baggins)
speaker: Bilbo Baggins

evidence.where: Search results and reference pages (Wikipedia, The Road Goes Ever On (song); Tolkien fan and scholarly pages) agreeing on the text and placement of the third version of the walking song, which Bilbo murmurs in Rivendell; no page of the 1955 Allen and Unwin printing was opened
evidence.locator: Book VI, chapter 6, Many Partings, lines 5 to 8 of Bilbo's verse

reason: The four lines close the third version of The Road Goes Ever On, murmured by Bilbo in Many Partings; wording, lineation and the hyphenated evening-rest match every reproduction. Shipped check is clean and Tolkien stands at 2 of 3 (months 5 and 7), so this would be his last line of the year; two Tolkien carry-ins also sit in the November pool, one per month.
